description: Every dated source/unit of the owner's real project history used by the temporal-holdout benchmark. A unit is an input for cut T iff available_at <= T (available_at is a conservative upper bound on when the content first existed). Dates recorded by tools that are known not to be content dates are kept but flagged.

date_trust_levels.high: date stated in/attached to the unit at creation time and consistent with independent evidence
date_trust_levels.medium: date from a secondary account or recovered file metadata, or two sources disagree by <= 2 days
date_trust_levels.derived: no trustworthy own date; bounded by other dated units (content identity, before/after relations)
date_trust_levels.artifact: recorded date known NOT to be the content date (bulk import, cherry-pick/rebase, later commit of an older document); usable only as an upper bound
